title.en: Five-transistor OTA with its bias mirror, and a testbench
title.zh: 五管 OTA（带偏置镜像）及测试台

description.en: A five-transistor OTA with an NMOS input pair, a PMOS mirror load and a mirrored tail current, in an open-loop testbench. Schematic generated by the RNL solver.
description.zh: 五管 OTA：NMOS 输入对、PMOS 镜像负载、镜像得到的尾电流，接在开环测试台里。原理图由 RNL 求解器生成。
